**Position: Resident Care Coordinator**

Sunday - Thursday

Pay Rate: $22- $24 depending on experience

Managed by Oakmont Management Group,we provide exceptional quality, comfort, and care with five-star services and amenities. Residents enjoy a rewarding lifestyle with individualized comprehensive support that promotes continuing independence. *We deliver meaningful lifestyles and relationships with residents, families, and team members by developing a winning culture and living these values: Authenticity \* Teamwork \* Compassion \* Commitment \* Resilience.*

* Pet Insurance

* Communicate with community healthcare professionals, including physicians, discharge planners, nurses, and state agencies on the care needs of residents as needed.
* Assist the Health Services Director in coordinating incidental medical, dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care for residents and arrange resident escorts s needed
* Participate in the community’s resident assessment program in accordance with company policy and state regulations.
* Recruit, develop, manage and schedule Care Providers and Medication Technicians.
* Maintain a safe and secure environment for all staff, residents, and guests, following established safety standards.
* Encourage teamwork through cooperative interactions with co-workers and other departments.

**Qualifications**:

* Must be at least eighteen (18) years of age.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Prefer one (1) year of experience supervising and managing employees.
* Ability to effectively train staff.
* Flexibility in work schedule as evidenced by working holidays, evenings, weekends, and additional shifts when necessary to ensure adequate coverage within the department.
* Able to operate a personal computer and be proficient in MS Office programs (Word, Excel, Publisher, PowerPoint, etc.).
* Must pass a Criminal Background check and Health Screening tests, including COVID-19 Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) test within 72 hours of start date.

**Oakmont Management Group,** based in Irvine, California, is a recognized leader in the senior living industry that manages a portfolio of communities under the Oakmont Senior Living and Ivy Living brands. OMG serves thousands of seniors across communities in California, Colorado**,** Nevada, and Hawaii. At OMG, we strive to create an atmosphere of family and community among team members, residents, and resident family members. We know that caring and meaningful relationships are the foundation of a rewarding life, and our team is hand-selected for their skills, previous experience, and passion for working with the elderly. Our practice is to incorporate joy and laughter alongside our expectations of excellence. Walk into our communities and feel our pride of ownership and commitment to service.

Oakmont Management Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer

**LunaVax Institute Nigeria**
-----------------------------

Skip ahead to take the next step and apply

### **Study Operations Coordinator (Volunteer)**

**Type**: Volunteer, Part-Time
  
**Location**: Remote (Nigeria-based preferred; applicants elsewhere are welcome)

**About LunaVax Institute Nigeria**
  
LunaVax Institute Nigeria is a research and implementation organization advancing vaccine access through research, innovation and implementation science. We focus on addressing measles and rubella immunization gaps, particularly among zero-dose children and communities that are difficult to reach, while generating evidence to inform the adoption of new vaccine delivery tools in Nigeria.

**Our Current Work**
  
We are preparing a Phase III effectiveness-implementation study comparing a needle-free measles-rubella microarray patch with standard injection in infants and toddlers across four Nigerian states, including facility and outreach settings. A preparatory pilot is planned before the main study.

Preparing a multi-state study involves many moving parts: protocol development with volunteer advisors, site identification and readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement, regulatory and ethics preparation, and evaluation of the digital and biometric tools that will support data collection. Our team includes volunteers, advisors and partner organizations across Nigeria and beyond.

**The Role**
  
We are seeking a Study Operations Coordinator to help keep our study preparation organized, on schedule and well documented. Working closely with the Founder & Director, you will coordinate tasks across workstreams, track deliverables and deadlines, and support the operational planning needed to move from protocol development to study start-up.

This is an opportunity to gain practical experience in clinical study coordination and operations, from early planning and site readiness to regulatory preparation and team coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate study preparation activities across workstreams, tracking tasks, owners, deadlines and progress
* Maintain project trackers, action logs and decision records, and follow up with team members on outstanding items
* Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, take notes and circulate action points
* Support site identification and readiness activities with implementation partners, including facility screening and readiness assessments
* Help draft and organize study documents, including standard operating procedures, checklists and operational plans
* Support preparation of ethics and regulatory submission materials, including tracking required documents and timelines
* Coordinate team preparation for technology partner demonstrations, including tracking training and collecting questions
* Maintain organized, version-controlled study files on SharePoint
* Support onboarding of new volunteers and help them settle into their workstreams
* Flag risks, delays and resource gaps early, and propose practical solutions

**Requirements**

* A degree in public health, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, life sciences or a related field (completed or in progress, including postgraduate students)
* Experience in project coordination, clinical research, public health programs or a similar operational role
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication, including following up with colleagues professionally
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word and Excel
* Reliability and accountability in completing agreed tasks
* Ability to commit around 5 to 8 hours per week for at least six months
* Commitment to confidentiality and responsible handling of study information

**Desirable Experience**

* Clinical trial coordination or research site experience
* Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training or certification
* Familiarity with ethics committee (HREC or NHREC) or NAFDAC submission processes
* Experience with immunization programs, primary health care or community health in Nigeria
* Experience coordinating volunteers, multi-site projects or remote teams
* Familiarity with digital data collection tools such as CommCare or ODK
* Knowledge of the Nigerian health system

**What You’ll Gain**

* Hands-on experience coordinating preparation for a planned Phase III vaccine study
* Exposure to protocol development, site readiness, regulatory preparation and technology evaluation
* Direct mentorship from the Founder & Director and opportunities to learn from advisors in clinical research, regulatory science and implementation science
* Collaboration with colleagues and partners across research, implementation and global health
* A portfolio of study coordination and operations work
* A certificate of service and a letter of recommendation on successful completion of your commitment
* A flexible, fully remote role that fits around study or other work commitments

**Engagement**
  
This is a volunteer role. The time commitment is around 5 to 8 hours per week, used flexibly, for a minimum of six months. It is fully remote, with meetings scheduled in advance, and you will sign a confidentiality agreement before starting. No participant data will be collected until ethics and regulatory approvals are in place. As funding is secured, we intend to develop paid roles and will consider contributors to our work, although we cannot guarantee this.
